'''2009 Bespin Regionals Riley Boeckman LS Endor: Hidden Forest Trail''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Riley Boeckman]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor: Hidden Forest Trail|Endor-L-endorhiddenforesttrail.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Endor Defence
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
